title: feat(app-shell): one page header for every Setup page — sys_* lists, metadata types, settings and component pages (objectui#12606)
body:
Fixes #12606
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

One header component, extended once: the console page header (`ConsolePageHeader`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/PageHeader.tsx`, the objectui#12553 base). No second Setup header was built.

- **Target 1, the header.** Inside the Setup app the header uses a Setup posture: a 32px icon tile, an 18px / 600 title, the kind chip after the title, a 13px muted description on its own line under the title, Refresh as an icon button, and the primary action at the right. The header reads the posture itself from the route's `:appName` (`setup` or `com.objectstack.setup`) through a new `useInSetupApp()` in `console/setupApp.ts`, so no page passes a prop for it. Outside Setup the header keeps the objectui#12423 one-row layout. There are three new optional props: `badge` (the kind chip, e.g. `ManagedByBadge` with its words unchanged), `breadcrumb` (leading crumbs on the description line) and `refresh` (`onRefresh`, `label`, `busy`). The Setup description line always draws, so a page without a description keeps the same title position.
- **Target 2, metadata-type pages under Setup** (Positions, Capabilities, Permission Sets, Datasources). They draw this header, with no 'All Metadata Types' breadcrumb and no Items / Filtered tiles. The count is the description ('18 items'). The source and status selects are filter chips. Table headers are sentence case, rows are 36px and cells are middle-aligned. The per-row Artifact chip is now plain text with its explanation in a tooltip. Outside Setup (the directory, Studio's Open in Setup target) the page keeps its old shape, and its `data-testid`s are unchanged.
- **Target 3, `sys_*` record lists under Setup.** There is no `#` row-number column. Display draws only when the object has more than four views. ObjectView reads the same route `:appName` and passes two new `ListView` host props, `defaultRowNumbers` and `showDisplayControl`. These are React props, not view keys, so no authored metadata changes.
- **Target 4, settings pages.** They keep their form and take the same header. 'All settings' is now the first crumb on the header's description line instead of a button at the top of the form.
- **Component pages.** Packages, Packaged automation, Approvals Inbox, Audit Log Browser and App Marketplace draw their title row through the header, with Refresh as its icon button. Only the header row changed. objectui#12609, objectui#12610, objectui#12607 and objectui#12637 are out of scope and untouched.

## Deviations

- `SETUP_APP_PACKAGE_ID` and `SETUP_APP_NAME` moved from `console/ConsoleShell.tsx` to `console/setupApp.ts` (ConsoleShell re-exports them, and the package root is unchanged). The header can then read them without importing the console shell.
- `metadata-admin/PageShell.tsx` exports `WritabilityBadge`. Metadata types have no `managedBy` bucket, so the existing writability badge (create-only / read-only / writable) is their kind chip.
- Two engine-table keys (en and zh) were added in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: `engine.list.itemCount` and `engine.list.itemCountOne`.
- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` gets the two host props. A plugin package cannot read the route.
- `metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` holds the Packages page header. That file is not under `views/setup/`.
- Connect an Agent is not converted. It is an authored page whose header is a `page:header` node, drawn by `packages/components`, which is outside this card's file surface.
- `SettingsView.pageHeader-12553.test.tsx` was updated: 'All settings' moved from the body into the header.

Title `getBoundingClientRect()`, read in the DOM at capture: x = 324, y = 68 on Users, Positions, Mail Delivery and Packages, the same at 1280 light, 1280 dark and 1024 light. The title is 18px / 600 and the description is 13px. Header components in the tree: 1 on each page, and one h1 per page. Users and Positions show no row-number cells. Users has five views, so it keeps Display; Positions shows no breadcrumb.

## Test evidence (head 877cc8b, the merge of origin/main 8614705)

- Full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite, run as 8 foreground shards (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --shard=K/8`; the container stops a foreground command at about 10 minutes): every shard exit 0. Files 1449 passed, 1 skipped; tests 13671 passed, 9 skipped.
- `packages/plugin-list/` with the console settings and system pages: 187 files, 1801 tests passed.
- New pins: `PageHeader.setupPosture-12606`, `ResourceListPage.setupPosture-12606`, `ObjectView.setupListChrome-12606`, `ListView.setupChrome-12606`. Each new pin was ablated once and turned red (e.g. the Setup posture forced off: 3 failed, 1 passed; the metadata-page branch disabled: 1 failed, 1 passed; ObjectView passing row numbers on: 3 failed, 1 passed). Each was restored with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `type-check` (app-shell, plugin-list, console), `build` (plugin-list, app-shell, console), eslint on the changed files (0 errors), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations` and the changeset-presence check: all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Under Setup, the Display control holds Refresh and Export in its footer. A `sys_*` list with four views or fewer therefore loses both under Setup, as the ruling requires.
- Below `sm`, the one-row posture hides the description line, so outside Setup the 'All settings' crumb is not drawn on a phone. The Setup posture keeps it.
